campaignTitle: Echoes of Home: The Atlas of Belonging

countries.name: Lebanon
countries.subtitle: The Harbor of Returning Stories
countries.theme: Coastlines, trade, alphabets, family memory and return
countries.visualIdentity: Stone harbor, docks, narrow souks, cedar motifs, bakeries, family courtyard, storytelling archive and sea cliffs.
countries.culturalWarning: The Isis/Osiris journey to Byblos is mythology, not evidence of the historical events; Phoenician writing should be contextualized, not called the single uncontested origin of all alphabets.

learnWords.en: Domed griddle for baking flatbread
Fragrant wild thyme, sesame, and sumac blend
Coastal harbor and stone dock

countries.name: Iraq
countries.subtitle: The Library That Travels
countries.theme: Knowledge shared, translated and preserved across generations
countries.visualIdentity: Tigris riverside walk, shanasheel houses, book market, manuscript workshop, date market and learning courtyard.
countries.culturalWarning: Present Bayt al-Hikma as historical scholarship with limits of reconstruction. Modern Al-Mutanabbi Street events must be handled sensitively; avoid violent reenactments and conflating Abbasid Baghdad with today.

learnWords.en: Carved wooden lattice balcony overhanging the street
Cardamom-spiced date pastry shared at celebrations
Wisdom and shared scholarly inquiry

countries.name: Egypt
countries.subtitle: The Lanterns of Cairo
countries.theme: Light, shared celebration and inherited craftsmanship
countries.visualIdentity: Cairo lanes and courtyard, lantern workshops, neighborhood market, food stall, rooftop view and Nile-linked trade exhibit.
countries.culturalWarning: The Fatimid lantern origin is a widely circulated tradition, not a single definitively established historical account. Distinguish contemporary Cairo from ancient Egyptian settings.

learnWords.en: Decorative brass and colored-glass lantern
Layered rice, lentils, pasta, tomato sauce, and crispy onions
Turned-wood geometric lattice screen

countries.name: France
countries.subtitle: The Hidden Passage and the Kitchen
countries.theme: Recipes, passages and the quiet persistence of craft
countries.visualIdentity: Renaissance courtyards, traboule-inspired walkways, silk looms, bouchon, bakery, market and river embankment.
countries.culturalWarning: Traboules have varied uses over time; do not imply every passage has a documented Resistance history. Present Mères Lyonnaises as diverse chefs rather than one singular myth.

learnWords.en: Covered passageway connecting courtyards and streets in Lyon
Neighborhood bread and pastry bakery
Historic silk weaver of Lyon

countries.name: South Korea
countries.subtitle: The Five Colors of Jeonju
countries.theme: Harmony through diversity of ingredients and generations
countries.visualIdentity: Hanok rooftops, wooden gates, onggi jars, stone paths, ingredient market, garden and community kitchen.
countries.culturalWarning: The historical origin of bibimbap is debated; five-color symbolism is an interpretation and should be marked as such. Do not substitute generic Japanese or Chinese assets.

learnWords.en: Traditional Korean timber-framed house with curved giwa roof tiles
Traditional Korean five-color harmony palette
Warm rice mixed with seasoned vegetables and savory sauces

countries.name: Germany
countries.subtitle: The Song and the Healing Question
countries.theme: Empathy over silent detachment; remembering without becoming trapped in nostalgia
countries.visualIdentity: Rhine river bend and cliffs, riverside village, safe boat route, forest trail, mythic Grail hall and renewing garden.
countries.culturalWarning: Lorelei and Parzival are literary/mythic tales and should not be presented as literal history. Remove drowning, trauma and religious coercion from child-facing gameplay; provide respectful historical framing.

learnWords.en: Compassion and active empathy for others
Wide navigable river current
A caring question that opens understanding

countries.name: China
countries.subtitle: The Valley Beyond the Blossoms
countries.theme: Change, memory and the impossibility of freezing a place in time
countries.visualIdentity: Peach forest, winding river, hidden pass, terraced valley, village homes, bamboo grove and moon-viewing courtyard.
countries.culturalWarning: Peach Blossom Spring is literary fiction. Chang’e’s moon story has multiple versions and should be introduced as folklore, not fact.

learnWords.en: Peach blossom flower
Warm reunion and gathering together
Natural change and renewal over time

countries.name: Japan
countries.nameNative: 日本 · みちのくの旅路
countries.subtitle: The Narrow Road Home
countries.theme: The journey itself can become a form of belonging
countries.visualIdentity: Travel roads, river crossings, inns, forest and coastal waystations, gardens, seasonal scenery and poetic viewpoints.
countries.culturalWarning: Bashō’s journey is historical literature; distinguish reconstructed poetic scenes from verified route facts. Haiku examples must be newly authored or rights-cleared translations.

learnWords.en: Journey and mindful travel across seasons
Short three-line seasonal poem observing nature
Connecting bridge between places and people

countries.name: Russia
countries.subtitle: The Bells Beneath the Lake
countries.theme: How stories preserve cultural memory when places change or disappear
countries.visualIdentity: Northern forest and lake, wooden settlement, lookout, mythic submerged-city vision, musical dock and archive hut.
countries.culturalWarning: Kitezh is folklore with historical variants, not a factual submerged city. Avoid romanticizing political violence or presenting spiritual-national exclusivity as moral truth; support plural interpretations.

learnWords.en: Clear forest lake
Traditional plucked multi-stringed folk instrument
Oral legend passed across generations

countries.name: Ukraine
countries.city: Kyiv founding hills / community music square
countries.subtitle: The Guardian of Songs
countries.theme: Collective cultural memory, music, craftsmanship and solidarity
countries.visualIdentity: River hills, wooden founding village, contemporary music square, artisan instrument workshop, community archive and gardens.
countries.culturalWarning: The Kyiv founders are chronicle legends. Kobzar traditions are varied; do not imply all practitioners were blind or use disability as a supernatural device. No graphic violence or combat reenactment.

learnWords.en: Ukrainian plucked string instrument combining lute and harp elements
Sung epic poems preserving oral cultural memory
Community solidarity gathering to build or restore together

countries.name: Morocco
countries.subtitle: The Living Circle
countries.theme: Belonging is created together through storytelling and hospitality
countries.visualIdentity: Medina-inspired lanes, bustling square, courtyard, craft market, mint garden, story dais and cultural heritage gallery.
countries.culturalWarning: Al Halqa is a living performance tradition, not one fixed text. Cultural/religious stories, including the Seven Saints, must be reviewed and presented respectfully without assigning sacred characters arbitrary game powers.

learnWords.en: Interactive audience circle gathered around a storyteller
Moroccan green tea infused with fresh spearmint
Hand-cut geometric glazed tilework
